verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents automatic token and cost tracking and custom dashboards that monitor cost across models, tags, or users. Per-request token usage is captured in trace logs, and aggregate cost and usage metrics are queryable. However, the evidence never explicitly shows time-period breakdowns in dashboards or per-request cost views inside dashboards, and there is no independent corroboration. missing for 10: explicit evidence of time-period cost/token breakdowns in dashboards, explicit per-request cost display in dashboards, independent or hands-on corroboration of the cost dashboards.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards
